skills.name: Push Trading Signal
skills.description: Push a trading signal (token, direction, entry/SL/TP) to a peer's agent

skills.name: React to Signal
skills.description: React +1 (agree) or -1 (disagree) to a peer's signal with conviction sizing

skills.name: Read Signal Feed
skills.description: Get cross-channel feed of trading signals from all connected peers

skills.name: Manage Friends
skills.description: Add, accept, or remove peer connections in the whisper network

skills.name: Manage Channels
skills.description: Create group channels (2-10 members), invite, kick, transfer ownership

skills.name: Paper Trading
skills.description: View paper trading positions and P&L from autonomous daemon reactions
